source: VGC: Fortnite officially confirms Pirate Shop Access Token drop rate (Nov 9, 2026), reporting Epic's Fortnite Status post
text:
Pirate Shop Tokens were added to Fortnite as part of its current mini-season, Fortnite Treasure Hunters, which started on November 1 and is set to end on December 5.
The tokens are part of a Treasure Hunt feature, which has been added to the game’s Battle Royale mode. Every time a player opens a chest in the game, there’s a small chance they’ll get a treasure reward.
These treasures have different rarities and range from loading screens and jam tracks to one-week-limited vehicles, decals and outfits.
Players who find it receive two tokens – one which can be activated at any point in 2026 between November 1 and December 15, and one which can be activated at any point in 2027 between January 1 and December 31.
When a token is activated, every single item in the Fortnite Shop which costs V-Bucks – skins, emotes, backpacks, pickaxes, instruments, cars, gliders, jam tracks and more – becomes entirely free to that player for the next 14 days.
Occasionally the game will have Treasure Hours, which will last a short period and will boost the drop rates for the Pirate Shop Access by 1.5x. Epic says this may sometimes be higher – during a recent Treasure Hour, Pirate Shop Access was boosted to 2x.
The company has previously stressed that the rate does not change depending on the player, so the likelihood doesn’t improve if you’re a new or returning player.
